summary: Indonesia Energy Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 13, 2026. The release provides an operational update on the K-29 well, spudded July 25, 2026, which had reached over 2,500 feet depth as of the filing date, and notes the President's upcoming presentation at the EnerCom conference. No special-situation event is present; the filing is a routine operational update on drilling progress and conference participation.
